Do I need a reservation?

Reservations are recommended, especially for dinner and weekends, and can be booked online or by phone. We also keep a portion of seating available for walk-ins, so you are always welcome to drop by and we will seat you as soon as a table opens.

Can you accommodate dietary restrictions and allergies?

Yes. Our menu is clearly marked for vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, and our kitchen can adapt many dishes. Please let your server know about any allergies when you order so we can guide you and take proper care in the kitchen.

Do you take large groups or private events?
We happily host groups and private gatherings. For parties of eight or more, please contact the restaurant in advance so we can arrange seating and, where available, a set menu or a private space.

Do you offer takeout or delivery?
Most locations offer takeout, and delivery is available in selected areas through our delivery partners. Ordering details can be found on our website.

Are you able to seat guests who use wheelchairs?
Yes. Our dining rooms and restrooms are designed to be accessible. If you have specific needs, let us know when booking and we will make sure everything is ready for your visit.

Can I bring my own wine?
Corkage is available at some locations for a small fee. Please call ahead to confirm the policy at the restaurant you plan to visit.

What are your opening hours?

Lunch is served from 11:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. and dinner from 5:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday. Hours may vary by location and on holidays, so please confirm with your local Wren before visiting.

Absolutely. We offer a children's menu, high chairs, and booster seats. Families are most comfortable during lunch and early dinner service.
